decoder.plain_value_domain: music: $00-$7F duration and $80-$8F note; sound-effect: $00-$8F delay/yield
decoder.unknown_policy: stop the current path; never infer an operand length
decoder.canonical_id_components: selected-bank context + parser-mode + APU channel + physical PRG offset
decoder.canonical_id_invariant: a stream/instruction ID has exactly one parser mode; a mismatch raises AudioExtractionError instead of merging music and sound-effect grammar
decoder.dynamic_edge_policy: canonical byte edges retain dynamic placeholders; executions resolve A3/A4, BC/BD and BE/BF with concrete per-track stacks
decoder.execution_state_scope: parser writes are modeled; per-tick envelope, auto-duty and pitch modulation are exposed as configuration but not time-synthesised
decoder.execution_stack_assumption: top-level track starts with empty loop-A, loop-B and call stacks
decoder.structural_cycle_policy: the first repeated PC plus loop/call stacks proves structural looping; execution continues until the same modeled parser state also repeats, then exports exact intro/cycle event slices
decoder.dpcm_gate_policy: $C4 is a trigger attempt: $4015=$0F is unconditional, while parameter reads and playback writes require runtime $06FD<$0A
decoder.timing_scope: music duration is in tempo ticks; command playback summaries expose the global $05F9/$05FA increment and exact SEC+ADC accumulator conversion to driver updates
decoder.voice_program_grammar: $00 terminal silence; $E0-$FF inline duty low nibble and same-tick continue; $A1 followed by LE16 absolute jump; every other byte is a level and yields
